exposure: country-specific neonatal care policies (e.g., visitation policies)
outcome: Parents' experiences with neonatal care disruptions
Application of Infant and Family-Centred Developmental Care (IFCDC)
cohort: Parents of preterm, sick, or low birth weight infants born during the first year of the COVID-19 pandemic who received special/intensive care.
finding: Significant country-specific differences were found in the application of Infant and Family-Centred Developmental Care (IFCDC) and parental presence during neonatal care disruptions caused by the COVID-19 pandemic.
country: Australia, Brazil, Canada, China, France, Italy, Mexico, New Zealand, Poland, Sweden, Turkey, Ukraine
